faqs.a: It uses the fonts installed on your device (Arial, Georgia, Verdana, and friends). The PNG bakes the text into pixels, so it looks identical everywhere. The SVG references the font by name, so it renders best on devices that have that font.
Keep it short: 1 to 3 characters work best (initials like 'JT'). Long words shrink to fit and lose impact. This tool is for simple text marks, not full wordmarks.
faqs.q: How much text should my logo have?

logo-maker.formula:
Canvas (size S, centre C = S/2):
  circle: arc(C, C, radius S x 0.42), filled with the background colour
  rounded square: side S x 0.84, corner radius side x 0.22
  square: side S x 0.84, sharp corners
  text: font-size = (size% / 100) x S, centred at (C, C)

SVG (512 x 512) mirrors the same geometry:
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="215"/> + <text text-anchor="middle"/>

Example: text 'JT', circle, indigo #4f46e5, white text, size 46%:
  PNG 1024: circle at (512, 512) radius 430; text 471 px, centred at (512, 512).
  SVG: <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="215.04" fill="#4f46e5"/> and
  <text x="256" y="256" font-size="235.52" fill="#ffffff">JT</text>.
